card.name: The word once in dosing frequency
card.fires_on: The word "once" (also "Once") in dosing schedules, right before daily, weekly or per day. Also seen as a conjunction at the start of a condition, such as "Once ANC ≥ 1000".

modes.label: Once before frequency
modes.description: "once" directly before daily, weekly, per day or every three weeks in a dose instruction.
modes.example: ARCALYST should not be given more often than<< once>> weekly.

modes.label: Once as a condition
modes.description: "Once" opens a clause that gives a threshold to reach before the next step.
modes.example: obtain ANC three times weekly •<< Once>> ANC ≥ 1000/

modes.label: Inside a brand name
modes.description: A piece of a test-brand name, with no link to dosing.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens show no clear link to dosing, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "once" when a label says how often to give a dose, like once weekly.
